newsitem.title: USA: Clinton sought role of party fund-raiser - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Clinton sought role of party fund-raiser - NYT.

text.p: President Clinton offered to call potential contributors in an effort to raise $1 million for the Democratic National Committee early last year, The New York Times reported Thursday.
The newspaper cited a White House memorandum recently turned over to congressional investigators that indicates Clinton personally requested a list of potential contributors whom he offered to call.
Clinton was presented with a list of donors several days after making the request, the paper said.
The list included named of people the Democratic committee thought would be especially receptive to an appeal "from you," the memorandum said, according to the story.
And in the weeks after Clinton asked to make the calls, five people on the list gave $50,000 and $100,000 checks to the Democrats, according to Federal Election Commission records, the story said.
